description.value:
The Monk is an unarmed combatant who has turned their own body into a weapon through years of rigorous discipline, drawing on a personal reservoir of focus points to fuel bursts of supernatural speed, resilience, and striking power. Whether raised in a hidden monastery, a reclusive order, or a self-taught life of austerity, the Monk needs no blaster or blade to be dangerous.

A Monk's fighting style is defined by the Monastic Vow they choose to follow as they advance, a personal code that reshapes how their focus points manifest — from serene, movement-based mastery to aggressive, strike-chaining ferocity — while always emphasizing speed, precision, and inner control over brute force.
